ops.sql: SELECT d.Diagram_ID, d.Object_ID, o.Name, d.RectLeft, d.RectTop, d.RectRight, d.RectBottom FROM t_diagramobjects d INNER JOIN t_object o ON d.Object_ID = o.Object_ID WHERE d.Diagram_ID IN (1218,1219,1220,1225) AND o.Object_ID BETWEEN 12051 AND 12059
SELECT Connector_ID, Start_Object_ID, End_Object_ID, Connector_Type FROM t_connector WHERE End_Object_ID = 12051
